name: Reusable Task Component Decomposition Process
purpose: Detect emerging orchestration ambiguity early and require extraction or reuse of reusable task components before progress is impeded.

repeated_subflow.description: Equivalent process appears in two or more Goal Tasks, repositories, providers, frameworks, or runtime paths.

multiple_authority_crossings.description: The process crosses three or more canonical authority owners or contains repeated authority transitions.

multiple_round_trips.description: The process requires two or more independently evidenced request/response or ingress/egress cycles.

cross_repository_or_org_spread.description: The process coordinates implementation across three or more repositories or more than one organization.

task_specific_adapter_duplicates_generic.description: A new adapter repeats transport, correlation, evidence, credential-session, runtime-resolution, or return-assembly work already present elsewhere.

handoff_sequence_growth.description: The canonical handoff contains a long ordered execution sequence whose steps have independent inputs, outputs, owners, or evidence.

failure_path_branching.description: Three or more distinct failure/remediation branches are embedded inside one process.

independent_reusability.description: A sub-process has a stable contract and useful meaning independent of the current Goal Task.

optional_subflow_present.description: A sub-process is required by some consumers but irrelevant to others.

independent_evidence_predicate.description: A sub-process produces evidence that can be validated independently of the parent flow.

automatic_process: replace task-specific implementation sequence with component references plus task-specific parameters
preserve Goal Task identity COSV and completion predicates
update canonical handoff and README architecture projection
validate component interfaces and original Goal Task composition
continue task execution without creating a human checkpoint
